description: This file implements the main frontend component for a Tic-Tac-Toe game, including UI rendering, game state management, simple AI logic, and styling with a custom theme.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Determines the current game winner or if the game is a draw based on the current board state.

methods.name: computeAIMove
methods.description: Calculates the AI's next move based on simple heuristics aimed at winning or blocking the human player.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: React functional component that renders a single game cell with styling and press handling.

methods.name: BoardView
methods.description: React component that renders the tic-tac-toe grid with individual squares and highlights the winning line.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that manages game state, user interactions, AI moves, and overall UI layout.
